text.tspan: 1. Determine the type of hypothesis test to use- for proportions or means.
We have studied two types of hypothesis tests. When we work with
proportions of samples with a characteristic to create the distribution of sample proportions. We can

, we use the sample mean and sample standard deviation to work
with the distribution of sample means. We can then use the methods of section 8.3 to conduct
. When you are asked to conduct a hypothesis test, you must first identify the parameter
of interest. If we are discussing qualitative variables and sample proportions, we use a hypothesis test
for a population proportion. If we are discussing quantitative variables and sample means, we use a
hypothesis test for a population mean.
